result.summary: The page appears mostly functional with one notable visual issue found.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' section has a dark/blurred background that makes it visually inconsistent with the other restaurant cards (Green Bowl Poké and Trattoria Piccolo), which have lighter backgrounds. This appears to be an unintended dark overlay or image rendering issue rather than intentional design.
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant thumbnail images are rendered consistently. Check if the image source for Smash Bros Burgers is correctly loaded or if there is an unintended overlay/filter being applied to that card.
